1.web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
1.asv: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

2.web: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
2.asv: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?

3.web: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
3.asv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

4.web: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
4.asv: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.

5.web: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?
5.asv: Who determined the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who stretched the line upon it?

6.web: Whereupon were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone,
6.asv: Whereupon were the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner-stone thereof,

7.web: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
7.asv: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

8.web: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
8.asv: Orwho shut up the sea with doors, When it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb;

9.web: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,
9.asv: When I made clouds the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddling-band for it,

10.web: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
10.asv: And marked out for it my bound, And set bars and doors,

11.web: and said, ‘Here you may come, but no further. Here your proud waves shall be stayed?’
11.asv: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further; And here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

12.web: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place;
12.asv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days began, And caused the dayspring to know its place;

13.web: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?
13.asv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, And the wicked be shaken out of it?

14.web: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
14.asv: It is changed as clay under the seal; Andall thingsstand forth as a garment:

15.web: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
15.asv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.

16.web: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?
16.asv: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?

17.web: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
17.asv: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? Or hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

18.web: Have you comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if you know it all.
18.asv: Hast thou comprehended the earth in its breadth? Declare, if thou knowest it all.

19.web: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,
19.asv: Where is the way to the dwelling of light? And as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

20.web: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?
20.asv: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest discern the paths to the house thereof?

21.web: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
21.asv: Doubtless, thou knowest, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!

22.web: Have you entered the treasuries of the snow, or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
22.asv: Hast thou entered the treasuries of the snow, Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

23.web: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
23.asv: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?

24.web: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
24.asv: By what way is the light parted, Or the east wind scattered upon the earth?

25.web: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm;
25.asv: Who hath cleft a channel for the waterflood, Or the way for the lightning of the thunder;

26.web: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; on the wilderness, in which there is no man;
26.asv: To cause it to rain on a land where no man is; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

27.web: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?
27.asv: To satisfy the waste and desolate ground, And to cause the tender grass to spring forth?

28.web: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?
28.asv: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

29.web: Out of whose womb came the ice? The gray frost of the sky, who has given birth to it?
29.asv: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

30.web: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.
30.asv: The waters hide themselvesand becomelike stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.

31.web: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?
31.asv: Canst thou bind the cluster of the Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?

32.web: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?
32.asv: Canst thou lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season? Or canst thou guide the Bear with her train?

33.web: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?
33.asv: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? Canst thou establish the dominion thereof in the earth?

34.web: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?
34.asv: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?

35.web: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’
35.asv: Canst thou send forth lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee, Here we are?

36.web: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?
36.asv: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the mind?

37.web: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of the sky,
37.asv: Who can number the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the bottles of heaven,

38.web: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?
38.asv: When the dust runneth into a mass, And the clods cleave fast together?

39.web: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
39.asv: Canst thou hunt the prey for the lioness, Or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

40.web: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?
40.asv: When they couch in their dens, Andabide in the covert to lie in wait?

41.web: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
41.asv: Who provideth for the raven his prey, When his young ones cry unto God, Andwander for lack of food?
